title: The Magical Girl of the Alps
overview: Yoshika leaps back into action to save her friend's father, but her striker unit almost blows up on the tarmac!

title: The Strike Witches Come Together
overview: When a Neuroi strikes at Europe's biggest supply port on the eve of humanity's counterattack, Yoshika must hold it off alone, without any weapons at all!

title: What the Two of Us Can Do
overview: Yoshika's lost control of her magic… again! It's time for more training and more hard work if she wants to get it back!

title: Beyond Two Hundred Miles Per Hour
overview: Shirley's world record was just broken, and she's not happy about it. As Shirley and Lucchini attempt to beat the new world record, an unusual Neuroi threat swiftly approaches.

title: Queen of Nederland
overview: The girls take a detour to Nederland, to help a legendary flower bloom.

title: Hounds of Vengeance
overview: When Erica is shot down in enemy territory, Gertrud will do whatever it takes to get her back.

title: They Go Boing-Boing
overview: A mysterious idol causes all the witches' breasts to grow bigger and bigger, and the girls gradually fall victim one by one...

title: Mina's Sky
overview: Rocket attacks from the Neuroi nest in Berlin are threatening the base in Kiel. Only Mina has what it takes to stop them, but her magic power is fading…

title: Shizuka, Come In!
overview: Operation Southwind begins with a full-scale air assault on Berlin. When Yoshika is ordered to stay behind to conserve her magic, Shizuka steps up to try and fill the hole.

title: Road to Berlin
overview: With Miyafuji's magic power disabled, humanity is forced to use its backup plan: the powerful Ratte tank. But can they win without their ultimate ace?

title: I Still Want to Protect
overview: Yoshika is trapped inside the dome around Berlin, and the rest of the Witches are cut off. Can they get inside to save her in time?
